title: AnalogScout: Simulation-Efficient PVT-Aware Analog Sizing with LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduce

translated_title: AnalogScout：基于大语言模型智能体的仿真高效、PVT感知的模拟电路尺寸设计
translated_abstract: 模拟器件尺寸设计必须在所有工艺、电压和温度（PVT）角点上满足全部规格，以确保流片成功，但在所有角点上对每个候选设计进行仿真占据了尺寸设计的大部分时间，减缓了设计迭代。传统的基于代理模型的优化器直接搜索尺寸设计空间，而近期的大语言模型（LLM）智能体虽然为设计引入了电路知识，但仍将尺寸设计任务委托给全局优化器。两者都依赖反复的多角点SPICE仿真来学习电路响应并在此基础上进行优化，这在仿真预算有限的情况下代价高昂。若能为智能体提供可复用的已验证设计以及解析式的子模块尺寸设计，则可节省大部分仿真预算。我们提出了AnalogScout，一个由LLM智能体驱动的仿真高效、PVT感知的尺寸设计框架。通过结合精英设计复用、解析式gm/Id局部尺寸设计以及在全角点验证下的全局细化，AnalogScout减少了……
tldr: AnalogScout是一个由LLM智能体驱动的框架，通过结合精英设计复用、解析式gm/Id局部尺寸设计与全局细化，在有限仿真预算下大幅减少多角点SPICE仿真次数，实现仿真高效的PVT感知模拟电路尺寸设计。
en_tdlr: AnalogScout is an LLM-agent-driven framework that combines elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing, and global refinement to achieve simulation-efficient PVT-aware analog sizing under a limited simulation budget.
